_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro: Urimo gukina Klondike Solitaire. Intego yawe ni ukujyana amakarita yose ku nkingi z'urufatiro. Amategeko y'umukino: - Inkingi z 'urwego (F1-F4): Kubaka kuva Ace kugeza Umwami mu myambarire - Ibikoresho by'ibaruramari (T1-T7): Gushiraho amabara ahinduranye (umutuku kumweru, umukara kuri umutuku) - Ububiko: Kuramo ikarita yo gusesagura inkingo - Imyanda (W): Karita ya mbere iboneka kugirango ukine Amabwiriza: - "kurema" - Kurama amakarito avuye mubikorwa byo gutakaza - 'kugenda <isoko> <ahantu hose> [count]' - Kuvana amakarata hagati yimirongo Ingero:" kwimuka W T1 "," kwimuka T1 F2 "," kugenda T3 T5 2 ". Birashobora kandi kuba" byose", bizagerageza guhita bimurira amakarite yose hejuru. - 'kubeshya " - Guhagarika imikino no gufunga amanota yawe muri iki gihe-Imyambaro: Pile W (was), F4 1-F4-T1, imikorere yibanze itangwayo), T7 (gukora ibyuma byinshi) Urashobora gukurikirana mugihe usiga urutonde rwimiterane rwijwe hamwe nuburyo bwimikino A-1, niba ibikorwa bisigaye bishyi bishobora gukorwa iyo abamiwe na commas ikosa wongeye gushyemeza ko ingamba igicya ifoto imwe gusa ushobora kubatsinda igikombe , kurubanza kimwe cyumusoro. Urugero: Kwikurikiririzo cyabakwugame ishobora gukoresha uburyo bwo gutsindwa kwinjiza abakiranirwa nimigenga.

format_error.no_brackets: Imiterere y'ibikorwa idakwiriye. Ibikorwa bigomba kuba mu nkingi.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Imiterere y'ibikorwa idakwiriye. Gifite agace ka nyuma ']'
format_error.empty_command: Itegeko ritagira icyo rivuga. Andika 'kurasa' cyangwa ' kwimura <isoko> <ahantu ugomba kujya > [count]'.
format_error.move_needs_args: Gusaba ko itegeko ryo kwimura rikenera isoko n'aho rigana. Gukoresha: 'gushyira <isoko> <ahantu ugenewe > [count]'.
